jobs.occupation: Senior Enterprise Account Executive – New Logo Sales
jobs.description: Tacton is looking for a Senior Account Executive who loves the hunt. In this net-new logo role, you'll own a territory of named enterprise manufacturers across Europe, open doors at companies new to Tacton, and close deals that help them make every customer promise one their factory can keep. You'll lead multi-stakeholder sales cycles of 6–12+ months, from first outreach to signature, engaging executives across sales, engineering, operations, and IT. Sales Engineering, Professional Services, Customer Success, and Marketing will support you, but the pipeline, deal strategy, and close are yours. You'll report to our SVP EMEA in a performance-driven sales organization with clear goals and transparent metrics. What you'll do  Hunt for new logos: Build pipeline across named target accounts together with your Business Development Manager  Open executive doors: Build trusted relationships with the C-suite, economic buyers, and champions across business and IT  Lead discovery and value mapping: Uncover challenges, quantify impact, and build the business case using the Tacton Sales Process  Run complex deal cycles: Keep multi-threaded opportunities moving and stakeholders aligned  Quarterback the team: Bring in Sales Engineering, Professional Services, and leadership at the right moments  Stay close to your market: Keep a steady cadence of calls, meetings, site visits, demos, and events  Negotiate and close: Lead commercial and legal negotiations to signature  Exceed your number: Consistently exceed your new-business quota Requirements  7+ years of enterprise software sales, with a proven record of winning new logos across multiple multi-year tenures  Consistent quota attainment, closing six- and seven-figure deals  Experience selling mission-critical enterprise systems (e.g., ERP, PLM, CRM, supply chain, or industrial software). Manufacturing experience is a strong plus; CPQ is a plus, not a requirement  Experience selling to executive buying committees  Daily hands-on use of AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot) to research prospects, prepare for meetings, and manage your pipeline  Experience from fast-growth, private equity-backed companies is preferred  Fluent English; German, French, or a Scandinavian language is a strong plus Who you are  A hunter at heart: Prospecting isn't a chore, it's how you win  Resilient: You hear "no" and keep going  A proven closer: You create urgency, navigate procurement, and get deals signed  Driven by the numbers: You own your metrics and see KPIs as tools to win  A value storyteller: You sell business outcomes, not features, to CFOs and VPs of Engineering alike  In it for the long game: You build pipeline that pays off in year two and beyond, and you've done it more than once  Present with customers: You build trust in person through site visits, workshops, and plant tours  A coachable team player: You take direction, share what works, and win with your team  Transparent: You believe in honesty and openness Recruitment process 1. Screening call with Talent Acquisition 2. Interview with the hiring manager 3. Personality and logical ability test 4. Second interview and peer meeting, including a case study or value pitch 5. Interview with senior management 6. Reference and background checks Why Tacton? Grow your career in a global, open organization that values teamwork and uses the latest technology to solve complex challenges in manufacturing.  33 days of paid time off (30 vacation days + 3 extra)  Premium occupational pension beyond ITP1  5,000 SEK annual wellness allowance  Private healthcare insurance  Parental leave top-up to 90% of base salary for up to 6 months  Weekly fika or breakfast * Hybrid setup: 3 days a week in the office Promise what you can build. Build what you promised. For 26 years, Tacton has helped manufacturers of complex products do exactly that. Through Tacton's Connected Suite, every configuration flows on one digital thread from product definition to the factory floor, and AI agents can promise only what can actually be built. Learn more at www.tacton.com

In this role, you will make significant contributions to high-profile strategic finance initiatives through support in business performance analysis and performance forecasting. This is a unique role where you will be working in the finance office of the HQ. This position presents a compelling growth trajectory and an invaluable learning opportunity for advancing your career within the strategic finance team of the CFO domain. It combines the exciting challenge of establishing a modern finance operation while conducting financial planning and analysis to support a fast-moving international group.This role is based in Stockholm, Sweden, working from the group headquarters.The role offers a wide range of opportunities, many of which will pose new challenges for the candidate. We are looking for a high potential and driven candidate that are quick to grasp concepts and with a strong process and system mindset. Key responsibilities encompass a range of areas (experience in all areas is not a prerequisite to apply, keen motivation and interest are sufficient):     Monitors and analyzes financial performance, key trends, cost structures, and profitability drivers across the group and its subsidiaries.    Tracks performance against budgets and forecasts, providing variance analysis, KPI tracking, and executive management reporting.    Partners in forecasting and scenario modeling to steer strategic decision-making and long-term financial planning.    Maintains and builds scalable financial models and FP&A tools in close collaboration with cross-functional teams.Qualifications:    2-3 years of experience, with prior experience in investment banking, strategy consulting, or financial analysis.    Adept at using and learning systems/software. Proficiency in accounting principles is a merit.    Exceptional analytical thinking and unwavering attention to detail, coupled with a robust sense of ownership.    Excellent proficiency in MS Excel.    Fluent in English; additional languages are a plus.While experience in the Tech industry is advantageous, we extend a warm welcome to candidates from diverse backgrounds eager to embrace and learn about this dynamic sector. If you possess the passion for establishing a modern finance function that can influence the success of a global Tech powerhouse, we invite you to apply and become a valued member of our team.We're interviewing candidates continuously and may fill the position ahead of the application deadline.

Company description:Ericsson ABJob description:   Join our Team   About this opportunitySPP is Ericsson’s internal management consultancy. We work closely with Ericsson’s Executive Team to deliver break-through impact through engagements on strategy, organization, corporate finance, sales, operations, and change. We are based in Stockholm but serve Ericsson globally. SPP offers highly-motivated and result- oriented management consultants:•    Relationships with and insight to Ericsson’s global Executive Team•    A strong team culture and learning curve combined with a sustainable worklife balance•    Opportunity to build an edge within the hightech and ICT industry on topics like 5G, IoT and cloud•    The satisfaction to see your recommendations get implemented and generate business value•    Professional development and rotation opportunities across Ericsson•    Access to a highpotential talent pool for global management roles within the Ericsson group•    Living in Stockholm, a city considered to be amongst the best in the world from a familylife and environmental standpoint•    Proximity to Stockholm’s thriving hightech and entrepreneurial ecosystem What you will doYou are an experienced management consultant with following qualifications:•    5+ years of fulltime work experience from top-tier management consulting firms (e.g. McKinsey, BCG, Bain) or similar experience (e.g. from investment banking, private equity, or corporate strategy)•    Experience in leading and delivering management consulting projects, including project planning, problem structuring, and team and client management•    Excellent academic track record from globally recognized business and/or engineering schools, typically with an advanced degree (M.Sc., Ph.D. or MBA)•    Excellent command of business English•    Prior strategy consulting experience in Telecom, Media and Technology (TMT) is highly valued but not a requirement Who you will work withThe SPP team is highly diverse and international. Most of our consultants have a background in top-tier strategy consulting, private equity, or corporate finance, and have studied at leading business schools and technical universities. How you will deliver impactAs an Engagement Manager, you will:•    Engage with senior client executives to understand and advise on their business problems•    Define projects and approaches for solving client problems and arrive at actionable recommendations•    Take full responsibility for delivering complex projects from start to end•    Lead teams of both SPP consultants and client stakeholders•    Be the dayto-day manager of project activities•    Be an inspiration role model for your SPP colleagues•    Leverage your consulting experience to bring best practices and methodologies•    Contribute as a subject matter expert within one or several areas relevant to SPP

We are looking for enthusiastic, responsible, and service-minded individuals to join our team at Omami, Central Station, GothenburgAbout the RoleAs a Restaurant Assistant, you will play an important role in ensuring smooth daily restaurant operations while delivering an excellent guest experience.You will work closely with the Restaurant Manager and other team members to maintain Omami's standards for food quality, cleanliness, efficiency, and customer satisfaction.Key Responsibilities1. Restaurant Operations    Support daily restaurant operations, including food preparation, order handling, and food service.    Ensure food is prepared and served according to Omami's recipes, quality standards, and presentation guidelines.    Maintain efficient workflows to ensure timely preparation and delivery of orders.    Assist with opening and closing procedures.    Support stock replenishment, inventory checks, and proper food storage. 2. Guest Service & Communication    Welcome guests with a friendly, professional, and positive attitude.    Take customer orders accurately and efficiently.    Explain Omami's Asian Street Food concept, menu items, and available options to guests.    Handle guest questions, feedback, and concerns professionally.    Contribute to a positive and memorable dining experience. 3. Food Safety, Hygiene & Cleanliness    Follow established food safety and hygiene procedures, including HACCP principles.    Maintain cleanliness of kitchen equipment, food preparation areas, dining areas, and service counters.    Follow proper food handling, storage, and temperature-control procedures.    Ensure compliance with company policies and applicable Swedish food safety regulations. 4. Teamwork & Operational Efficiency    Work collaboratively with colleagues to achieve daily operational targets.    Support team members during busy service periods.    Follow instructions from the Restaurant Manager and shift leaders.    Participate in team training and continuous improvement activities.    Help create a respectful, supportive, and positive working environment. 5. Order Handling & Digital Systems    Operate the point-of-sale (POS) system accurately.    Process customer payments and follow order handling procedures.    Handle orders received through delivery platforms and digital ordering systems.    Use internal communication and scheduling applications as required. Qualifications & Requirements    Previous experience in a restaurant, café, fast-casual dining, or hospitality environment is an advantage.    A genuine interest in food, hospitality, and customer service.    Good communication skills in English; Swedish language skills are an advantage.    Ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced restaurant environment.    Strong teamwork skills, reliability, and a positive attitude.    Willingness to learn new tasks and follow company procedures.    Basic knowledge of food hygiene and safety is desirable.    Flexibility to work evenings, weekends, and public holidays according to the restaurant schedule.     Previous restaurant experience is preferred but not mandatory. We will provide training to suitable candidates.Personal QualitiesWe are looking for someone who is:    Service-minded: Passionate about creating excellent guest experiences.    Responsible: Reliable, punctual, and committed to quality.    Team-oriented: Cooperative, respectful, and supportive.    Efficient: Able to manage multiple tasks while maintaining high standards.    Adaptable: Comfortable working in a dynamic and fast-paced environment.    Motivated: Interested in learning, improving, and growing with Omami. What We Offer    An opportunity to join a growing Asian Street Food restaurant concept.    A friendly, inclusive, and multicultural working environment.    On-the-job training and professional development.    Opportunities for career progression within the Omami organisation.    A dynamic workplace where teamwork, initiative, and performance are valued.    Employment conditions in accordance with applicable Swedish employment regulations. How to ApplyIf you are passionate about food, enjoy working with people, and want to be part of an ambitious restaurant team, we would love to hear from you!Please submit your CV and a short introduction about yourself, mentioning your relevant experience, availability, and why you would like to work at Omami.Application Email: HR@omamigroup.seApplication Deadline: 20 November 2026Work Location: Gothenburg Central StationJoin Omami Central AB and be part of our journey to bring exciting Asian Street Food experiences to more guests!OMAMI – Asian Street Food | Great Food. Great People. Great Experience.

jobs.occupation: Domain Data Steward - ESG Data Domain
jobs.description: Are you passionate about the intersection of sustainability and data quality and want to help shape how Swedbank governs the ESG data that matters most to regulators, customers and the bank's long-term strategy?In Swedbank you have the opportunity to:• Be part of the ESG Data Domain and help establish data governance practices for ESG data across the Group• Coordinate collection of common ESG data definitions — and maintain them in the Bank’s Central Glossary• Investigate and document data lineage end-to-end, from systems of origin through calculation engines to reporting outputs• Document key ESG data processes in the Bank’s Information Management Tools• Gather and evaluate ESG data quality requirements from business stakeholders and translate these into domain-level data quality rules• Coordinate implementation of domain-level data quality rules into data quality controls in IT systems• Support business stakeholders and IT teams to ensure data governance expectations are met from the start in ESG data change initiativesWhat is needed in this role:• An academic degree in information management, data science, computer science, finance, economics, environmental studies or a related field — or proven experience in these areas• Two to five years of experience in data-centric roles such as Data Analyst, Business Analyst, IT Analyst, Data Steward or similar, ideally within banking or financial services• Solid understanding of core data management and data governance principles.• Ability to translate regulatory and business requirements into technical solutions, acting as a key link between business stakeholders, data consumers, and IT teams.• Familiarity with ESG regulations and reporting requirements, including — CSRD/ESRS, EBA Pillar 3, SFDR and EU Taxonomy — and an understanding of how ESG data is used beyond disclosure, including in credit, risk and in product development• Working knowledge of data retrieval and analysis tools, including SQL, Excel and BI tools such as Power BI or MicroStrategy• A solution-oriented individual capable of independently conducting detailed analysis and driving resolution of data gaps across a complex stakeholder landscape• Fluent in English; Swedish is an advantageWith us, you can experience:    Personal and professional growth through self-leadership and continuous development.    Meaningful work that positively impacts our workplace, our customers, and society.    An open and collaborative culture that encourages cross-functional teamwork and provides networking opportunities.    A supportive and inclusive environment that promotes a balanced and sustainable work-life, with flexible working conditions when suitable for the role.    Benefits such as our share based reward program Eken, company pension plan, employee offer for banking products, health insurance."Join our team and...ESG data is moving from regulatory requirement to a core input for how we lend, manage risk and serve customers. As ESG Domains Data Steward, you will play a key role in identifying, defining, and quality assuring ESG data across the Group. You will work closely with colleagues across sustainability, risk, finance, and business areas in all our home markets, contributing to cross functional solutions and building structures that are still taking shape. Be part of a team to help Swedbank identify, define and quality-assure ESG data with the chance to shape something that is currently being built." Jannike Hising, your future managerWe look forward to receiving your application by 22.11.2026. Location: Stockholm, SundbybergRecruiting manager: Jannike Hising We may begin the selection during the application period, so we welcome your application as soon as possible.We would like to let you know that a background check and a drug test may be a part of the process for this role.We have made our choice regarding recruitment media and therefore kindly decline contact with ad sellers or sellers of other recruitment services.Swedbank does not discriminate anybody based on gender, age, sexual orientation or sexual identity, ethnicity, religion or disability – everybody is welcome. #LI-MA1#LI-Hybrid

Mission Brief  The Propulsion Test Design Engineer is part of a multidisciplinary team responsible for the development and verification testing of liquid rocket engines and their subsystems. The role focuses on the design, performance, maintenance, and continuous improvement of propulsion test facilities and ground support equipment, while supporting test operations, commissioning, and troubleshooting activities. Your Role in Our Space Mission:     Plan and execute maintenance, modifications, and upgrades of propulsion test facilities to support current and future test campaigns.      Monitor, analyse, and improve the performance, reliability, and availability of facility systems through data analysis and troubleshooting.      Design, build, and commission test benches, test equipment, and facility upgrades.      Develop and improve procedures, risk assessments, and operational processes to ensure safe and efficient test operations.      Perform fault investigations, root cause analysis, and corrective actions on facility systems and test equipment.      Support test preparations, commissioning, test execution, and anomaly resolution in collaboration with test engineers, operators, and technicians.  Qualification Checklist     Relevant engineering qualification or engineering bachelor’s or master’s degree in the field of aerospace, mechanical engineering or similar      Hands-on experience in development or testing of complex systems, preferably involving extreme operating conditions such as cryogenic temperatures, high pressures, or high temperatures. Such experience can come from either relevant positions held, or internships, clubs, and other extra-curricular activities      Capable of designing fluid and mechanical systems from theoretical concept to realization and commissioning      Able to perform in high-stress environments, maintaining focus and concentration for long durations      Physical dexterity is required as working in confined spaces is necessary     Able to lift and carry 25kg     Fluent in English   Bonus Skills     Hands-on experience with fluid system and piping/tubing      Experience with at least one programming language (Python, Matlab, C, C#, Cobol...)      Knowledge of hazardous systems (cryogenic, flammable, explosive, or similar)

jobs.occupation: Technical Procurement Manager– Utility-scale solar and BESS
jobs.description: Do you want to lead procurement for the construction of the largest solar and battery storage projects in the Nordics? We are looking for a skilled procurement professional with a strong commercial foundation and the curiosity to understand technical solutions in depth. You are willing to dig into specifications, ask questions and work closely with engineers and suppliers to make well-informed purchasing decisions in a rapidly evolving industry. Join us and be part of an ambitious team building the energy infrastructure of tomorrow.What will you do at NYAB? As our Technical Procurement Manager, you will work at the intersection of long-term sourcing strategy and practical project delivery, leading procurement for utility-scale solar and battery energy storage system (BESS) projects. Your scope will include core components and services such as solar modules, inverters, mounting systems, transformers, batteries, subcontractors and related technical solutions. In this role, you will:     Own and develop the end-to-end procurement lifecycle, from early tendering and supplier evaluation to contracting and execution.     Lead strategic and commercial negotiations to secure competitive terms, balanced risk positions and strong contractual outcomes.     Evaluate supplier offers against technical requirements, cost, quality and delivery needs, working with engineering colleagues to clarify specifications and understand trade-offs.    Stay ahead of the market by identifying new technologies, suppliers and system solutions that strengthen our renewable energy projects and make our supply chain more resilient    Drive procurement priorities against project requirements, schedules and budgets – and make sure we deliver. You will act as our internal product owner, digging into specifications, drawings and technical documentation together with the engineering team until you know the product as well as the supplier does. About you You are a goal-oriented self-starter with the persistence to follow through and make things happen. You combine sound commercial judgment with technical curiosity and a willingness to work through details, ask questions and understand what you are buying. You remain composed during complex contractual discussions and take ownership of your commitments, combining speed with precision and going the extra mile when it matters. Along the way, you build trust with colleagues, suppliers and partners.We believe you have:     A master’s degree in engineering, preferably within electrical engineering, mechanical engineering or energy systems.     At least three years of hands-on experience in large-scale procurement projects with complex technical scopes, ideally in an EPC environment.     Experience in end-to-end sourcing, supplier management and commercial or contractual negotiations.     Strong cost awareness and the ability to manage priorities within time and budget constraints.     Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.     The willingness to travel internationally to meet suppliers and partners, and to visit project sites in Sweden and abroad. It is an advantage if you have:     Experience in construction, electrical systems, renewable energy or another technically complex project environment.     Experience procuring equipment or services for solar parks, BESS or related energy infrastructure.     Excellent written and verbal communication skills in Swedish.Why work at NYAB? NYAB's greatest strength is our drive and the pride we take in our work. We all pull in the same direction – forward. We value people for their competence and initiative, and you get the freedom to act along with the accountability that comes with it. Our entrepreneurial spirit is built on collaboration and commitment. We are a close-knit community where colleagues support one another, share knowledge and work together to find solutions when new challenges arise. You will never work alone – you will have the support of colleagues and leaders, and plenty of room to grow. We also offer:    Comprehensive health assessments     Generous wellness allowance     Parental pay supplement    Reduced working hours – (Sw: arbetstidsförkortning)    A secure pension planReady to make it happen? Apply with your CV or LinkedIn profile. We review applications on an ongoing basis and look forward to hearing from you. Start: As agreed   Employment type: Full-time   Location: Hägersten, Stockholm

jobs.employer_name: H & M Hennes & Mauritz GBC AB
jobs.description: Company DescriptionAs Trade & Customs Operations Manager, you will lead and develop Trade & Customs operations across the Logistics Continent, ensuring our cross-border flows are efficient, compliant and built for future growth. You will set priorities for continent Trade operations and work closely with local Trade & Customs teams and Global Trade. The role combines strategic leadership with operational responsibility, covering import and export flows, performance, compliance, cost, risk and continuous improvement.  In this role, you will:     Lead continent Trade operations across cross-border inbound, outbound, returns and DC movement flows.     Define operational goals and priorities and lead Trade teams across the continent towards common objectives.     Work closely with local Trade & Customs teams, following up operational performance, KPIs, costs and data quality.     Own and follow up the continent Trade budget, including financial reporting, duty costs and Trade Operations-related invoice control.     Ensure compliance with import and export standards and requirements for commercial and non-commercial goods moving under customs control.     Drive operational excellence and continuous improvement, balancing cost, service levels, sustainability and end-to-end flow performance.     Lead Trade security and risk management activities across the continent.     Build strong relationships with Trade suppliers and follow up performance, compliance, agreed targets and SLAs.     Support Trade-related procurement needs and participate in procurement processes.     Act as a key Trade & Customs contact for markets across the continent.     Collaborate closely with Global Trade to strengthen compliance, performance and cross-continent synergies.     Support the establishment and development of local Trade & Customs teams as the business expands.     Stay close to end-to-end logistics performance, KPIs, operational issues and risks.     Identify opportunities to improve sustainability from social, economic and environmental perspectives.     Where applicable, oversee continent inland haulage operations from port to distribution centre.  WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH Collaboration is at the heart of this role. You will connect teams and perspectives across the Logistics Continent to create strong, compliant and efficient Trade operations. You will work closely with:     Local Trade & Customs teams     Global Trade     Continent Markets     Logistics and cross-border operations teams     Commercial and procurement stakeholders     Trade suppliers and external partners You will play an important role in connecting local, continent and global perspectives and turning them into practical priorities and actions.  WHO YOU ARE We are looking for someone who combines deep Trade & Customs expertise with strategic thinking, strong leadership and a hands-on approach to execution. We believe you have:     Deep expertise in strategic Trade processes, international trade operations and compliance.     Strong knowledge of import/export operations, Trade documentation and customs-controlled goods.     A strong strategic and analytical mindset with the ability to turn trends and future developments into clear plans and actions.     Good understanding of end-to-end logistics, particularly international shipping, procurement and vendor management.     Strong commercial understanding and experience working with budgets, operational costs and performance follow-up.     The ability to manage multiple priorities and delegate effectively in a complex environment.     Experience building productive relationships with internal and external stakeholders at different levels of seniority.     Strong people leadership skills, with the ability to plan, organize, delegate and enable teams to deliver.     Experience driving change and implementing new ways of working.     Understanding of both retail and online business needs.  And importantly, you enjoy bringing people together. You are curious, analytical and open-minded, and you know how to move between strategic direction and operational reality. You create clarity, take ownership and keep progress moving even when priorities are complex. Additional InformationThis is a full-time role and can be located in Stockholm, Madrid, Amsterdam & Warsaw. jobs.occupation: Head chef to Mr.Bronck & Sallys at Sheraton Stockholm Hotel
jobs.description: Stockholm outside, a world of guests inside, and a kitchen ready for your ideas. It´s time to bring your flavour to Sheraton Stockholm.  Sheraton Stockholm has been bringing people together in the heart of the city since 1971. Today, we’re shaping our next chapter, with a major transformation, fresh energy and new places to eat, drink and connect. With Archer Hotel Management as our operator and Marriott International as our brand family, we combine an international outlook with a strong sense of place. Now we’re looking for a Head Chef to lead the food experience at Mr. Bronck, Sally’s and our room service operation. Someone with a clear culinary point of view, a head for business and the ability to build a team people want to be part of.  From dinner at Mr. Bronck to food that complements a cocktail at Sally’s or a great meal delivered upstairs, you’ll make sure every experience feels considered, consistent and right for the setting. You’ll lead the daily a la carte kitchen operation and develop seasonal menus that give each concept its own character. Taste, presentation and timing matter equally, and you know how to deliver all three when service picks up. Behind every great service is a well-run kitchen You’ll take ownership of menu costing, purchasing, stock control and staffing, keeping quality high and food waste low. You’ll turn business forecasts into smart schedules, maintain strong food safety and HACCP routines, and keep a close eye on the financial performance of the operation. Just as importantly, you’ll recruit, coach and develop your team. You set clear expectations, share your knowledge and stay approachable under pressure. Working closely with colleagues across the hotel, you’ll help create a seamless experience for our guests. A creative chef and a grounded leaderYou bring at least five years of experience in a similar leadership role in a quality restaurant or hotel kitchen. You’re confident developing menus, leading busy services and balancing culinary ambition with commercial results. You care about the details and understand how your decisions affect the whole operation. You bring structure, curiosity and high professional standards, and you enjoy finding practical solutions when plans change. Your team can count on you for direction, support and a steady presence during a demanding service. You communicate confidently in English; Swedish is a plus. An established network within the industry is also welcome. Make your mark on our next chapterThis is an opportunity to influence the food, develop your team and help shape the next chapter of an iconic Stockholm hotel. You’ll join an international, inclusive workplace with opportunities to grow within Sheraton and the wider Marriott family, alongside access to employee hotel rates around the world. We offer a permanent, full-time position with a six-month probationary period and terms covered by a collective bargaining agreement.Are you ready to bring your ideas to the table?Send us your application. We review applications and meet candidates throughout the recruitment process, so the position may be filled before the closing date. Let’s create something worth coming back for.
